scope: Proposition 37.5 (Expansions of the given branch) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 234. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every prescribed seed and branch in the theorem, set p = 2 and take uj, Fj, Bj from Lemma 37.4. If the seed has the form (37.9), we may instead take p = 4 with the finite coefficient construction. In both cases, ψ − p X j=1 ϵj uj β = O(ϵp+1 ), Lψ − p X j=1 ϵj Fj 2β = O(ϵp+1 ), ∂sψ|S − p X j=1 ϵj Bj C0(S) = O(ϵp+1 ). (37.16) The area and all four mass components have actual expansions to the same order. Their mass coefficients are (37.17) aµj[q] = Gµ(uj, Fj, Bj), pµ(ϵ) = pµ(0) + p X j=1 ϵj aµj[q] + O(ϵp+1 ). In particular, the actual deficit satisfies (37.18) Dq(ϵ) = c2[q]ϵ2 + O(ϵ3 ) for every seed under consideration. The coefficient c2 is a continuous quadratic form on Tτ,α in the ∥ · ∥β topology, invariant under rotations. For seeds of the form (37.9) there is additionally the actual expansion (37.19) Dq(ϵ) = c2[q]ϵ2 + c3[q]ϵ3 + c4[q]ϵ4 + O(ϵ5 ). The subsequent geometric arguments determine the signs and the vanishing of these coefficients.
